offending_extra_words: and no take-or-pay, shortfall, or similar charge applies
reasons: Preferred level is fully satisfied: the take-or-pay commitment is removed and Fees are expressly limited to Services ordered under an Order Form, with no shortfall exposure.
Fallback elements (12-month cap, 30-day reduction notice, true-up) are absent, but that is immaterial because the locked preferred level is met and the two levels are separate bargains.

Minimality fails: the whole sentence was rewritten and the deterministic gate reports a 0.914 changed-character ratio against a 0.600 limit; a shorter deletion or replacement of the commitment language would suffice.

The added take-or-pay/shortfall carve-out duplicates the protection already given by "makes no minimum purchase or volume commitment," and "and actually used" narrows the payment trigger beyond what the preferred position requires.
Intent is preserved: no undefined terms are introduced (Order Form and Services are defined), and the edit aligns with Vendor's acknowledgement in § 12.3 that no minimum-volume commitment was made.
